------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m5p2t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Surgeries, Rooms, Physicians, Quorum, NULL

VARIABLES pool, room, done, ballot
vars == <<pool, room, done, ballot>>

Occupied == { r \in Rooms : room[r] # NULL }
InRooms  == { room[r] : r \in Occupied }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \subseteq Surgeries
    /\ room \in [Rooms -> Surgeries \cup {NULL}]
    /\ done \subseteq Surgeries
    /\ ballot \in [Surgeries -> SUBSET Physicians]

Init ==
    /\ pool = Surgeries
    /\ room = [r \in Rooms |-> NULL]
    /\ done = {}
    /\ ballot = [s \in Surgeries |-> {}]

Vote(p, s) ==
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ p \notin ballot[s]
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = ballot[s] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, room, done>>

Commit(s, r) ==
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ room[r] = NULL
    /\ Cardinality(ballot[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ pool' = pool \ {s}
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED done

AdminAssign(s, r) ==
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ room[r] = NULL
    /\ pool' = pool \ {s}
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED done

Complete(r) ==
    /\ room[r] # NULL
    /\ done' = done \cup {room[r]}
    /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, ballot>>

Reopen(s) ==
    /\ s \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {s}
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<room, ballot>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Physicians, s \in Surgeries : Vote(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms : Commit(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms : AdminAssign(s, r)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Complete(r)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries : Reopen(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation ==
    /\ pool \cup InRooms \cup done = Surgeries
    /\ pool \cap InRooms = {}
    /\ pool \cap done = {}
    /\ InRooms \cap done = {}
=============================================================================

------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m7p1t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, MaxVer, NONE

VARIABLES ver, winner, seen, inflight
vars == <<ver, winner, seen, inflight>>

Slots == 0 .. (MaxVer - 1)

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ winner \in [Slots -> Machines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ seen \in [Machines -> 0 .. MaxVer]
    /\ inflight \subseteq (Machines \X (0 .. MaxVer))

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ winner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ seen = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ inflight = {}

Read(m) ==
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![m] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, winner, inflight>>

Submit(m) ==
    /\ <<m, seen[m]>> \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<m, seen[m]>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, winner, seen>>

Deliver(m, e) ==
    /\ <<m, e>> \in inflight
    /\ e = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ winner' = [winner EXCEPT ![ver] = m]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, e>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED seen

Drop(m, e) ==
    /\ <<m, e>> \in inflight
    /\ e # ver
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, e>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, winner, seen>>

Cycle ==
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ winner' = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ seen' = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ inflight' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Read(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Submit(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, e \in 0 .. MaxVer : Deliver(m, e)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, e \in 0 .. MaxVer : Drop(m, e)
    \/ Cycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A s \in Slots : (s < ver) <=> (winner[s] # NONE)
=============================================================================

    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxEpoch, NONE

VARIABLES epoch, token, inBay, known, crashed
vars == <<epoch, token, inBay, known, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ token \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ inBay \subseteq Cranes
    /\ known \in [Cranes -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ token = NONE
    /\ inBay = {}
    /\ known = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ token' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inBay, known, crashed>>

Sync(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ known[c] # epoch
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, token, inBay, crashed>>

Grant(c) ==
    /\ token = NONE
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ known[c] = epoch
    /\ token' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inBay, known, crashed>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ token = c
    /\ inBay = {}
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ inBay' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, token, known, crashed>>

Exit(c) ==
    /\ c \in inBay
    /\ inBay' = inBay \ {c}
    /\ token' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, crashed>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ inBay' = inBay \ {c}
    /\ token' = (IF token = c THEN NONE ELSE token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, token, inBay, known>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Sync(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Grant(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Exit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Recover(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
    \A c \in inBay : \A d \in inBay : c = d
=============================================================================

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Sites, MaxSeq, NONE

VARIABLES holder, curSeq, armed, inflight, served
vars == <<holder, curSeq, armed, inflight, served>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Sites \cup {NONE}
    /\ curSeq \in 0 .. MaxSeq
    /\ armed \subseteq Sites
    /\ inflight \subseteq (Sites \X (0 .. MaxSeq))
    /\ served \subseteq Sites

Init ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ curSeq = 0
    /\ armed = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ served = {}

Act(n) ==
    /\ n \in armed
    /\ n \notin served
    /\ served' = served \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, curSeq, armed, inflight>>

Pass(n, m) ==
    /\ n \in armed
    /\ curSeq < MaxSeq
    /\ armed' = armed \ {n}
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<m, curSeq + 1>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curSeq, served>>

Accept(m, s) ==
    /\ <<m, s>> \in inflight
    /\ s > curSeq
    /\ holder' = m
    /\ curSeq' = s
    /\ armed' = armed \cup {m}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED served

DropStale(m, s) ==
    /\ <<m, s>> \in inflight
    /\ s <= curSeq
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<m, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, curSeq, armed, served>>

Retire(n) ==
    /\ n \in armed
    /\ curSeq = MaxSeq
    /\ armed' = armed \ {n}
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curSeq, inflight, served>>

Reinject(n) ==
    /\ armed = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ holder' = n
    /\ armed' = {n}
    /\ curSeq' = 0
    /\ served' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Sites : Act(n)
    \/ \E n \in Sites, m \in Sites : Pass(n, m)
    \/ \E m \in Sites, s \in 0 .. MaxSeq : Accept(m, s)
    \/ \E m \in Sites, s \in 0 .. MaxSeq : DropStale(m, s)
    \/ \E n \in Sites : Retire(n)
    \/ \E n \in Sites : Reinject(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Authorized ==
    /\ \A a \in armed : \A b \in armed : a = b
    /\ (holder = NONE) => (armed = {})
    /\ (holder # NONE) => (armed = {holder})
=============================================================================

    MaxSeq = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT Authorized

CONSTANTS Drones, Zones, MaxCap, NONE

VARIABLES leader, burning, doused, cap, alive

    /\ leader \in Drones \cup {NONE}
    /\ burning \subseteq Zones
    /\ doused \subseteq Zones
    /\ cap \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ alive \subseteq Drones

    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ burning = Zones
    /\ doused = {}
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ alive = Drones

Elect(d) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ d \in alive
    /\ leader' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<burning, doused, cap, alive>>

FailLeader ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<burning, doused, cap, alive>>

Deploy(z) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ z \in burning
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ burning' = burning \ {z}
    /\ doused' = doused \cup {z}
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

Ignite(z) ==
    /\ z \notin burning
    /\ z \notin doused
    /\ burning' = burning \cup {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, doused, cap, alive>>

Resupply ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, burning, doused, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Elect(d)
    \/ FailLeader
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Deploy(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Ignite(z)
    \/ Resupply

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Irreversible == burning \cap doused = {}

    /\ queue \subseteq Cmds

    /\ qcap \in 1 .. MaxCap

    /\ queue = {}

    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, queue, executed, qcap>>

    /\ <<c, gen>> \notin queue
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {<<c, gen>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, executed, qcap>>

    /\ owner[g] = c
    /\ executed' = executed \cup {<<c, g>>}
    /\ queue' = queue \ {<<c, g>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, qcap>>

    /\ owner[g] # c
    /\ queue' = queue \ {<<c, g>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, executed, qcap>>

Recap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1 .. MaxCap
    /\ k # qcap
    /\ qcap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, owner, queue, executed>>

    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Enqueue(c)

    \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Gens : Drop(c, g)

CONSTANTS Printers, Total, MaxVer

VARIABLES reservoir, tank, ver, inflight
vars == <<reservoir, tank, ver, inflight>>

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ {x})

Reqs == Printers \X (0 .. MaxVer)

TypeOK ==
    /\ reservoir \in 0 .. Total
    /\ tank \in [Printers -> 0 .. Total]
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ inflight \subseteq Reqs

    /\ reservoir = Total
    /\ tank = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ inflight = {}

Request(p) ==
    /\ <<p, ver>> \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<p, ver>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservoir, tank, ver>>

Commit(p, rv) ==
    /\ <<p, rv>> \in inflight
    /\ rv = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ reservoir > 0
    /\ reservoir' = reservoir - 1
    /\ tank' = [tank EXCEPT ![p] = tank[p] + 1]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<p, rv>>}

Retry(p, rv) ==
    /\ <<p, rv>> \in inflight
    /\ rv # ver
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<p, rv>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservoir, tank, ver>>

Recycle(p) ==
    /\ tank[p] > 0
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ tank' = [tank EXCEPT ![p] = tank[p] - 1]
    /\ reservoir' = reservoir + 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Compact ==
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ inflight' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservoir, tank>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Request(p)
    \/ \E p \in Printers, rv \in 0 .. MaxVer : Commit(p, rv)
    \/ \E p \in Printers, rv \in 0 .. MaxVer : Retry(p, rv)
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Recycle(p)
    \/ Compact

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == reservoir + SumF(tank, Printers) = Total

------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p0t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Matches, Servers, Quorum, NONE

VARIABLES votes, session, launched, crashed
vars == <<votes, session, launched, crashed>>

OnSomeServer(m) == \E s \in Servers : session[s] = m

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Matches -> SUBSET Players]
    /\ session \in [Servers -> Matches \cup {NONE}]
    /\ launched \subseteq Matches
    /\ crashed \subseteq Players

Init ==
    /\ votes = [m \in Matches |-> {}]
    /\ session = [s \in Servers |-> NONE]
    /\ launched = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Vote(p, m) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ p \notin votes[m]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = votes[m] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<session, launched, crashed>>

Launch(m, s) ==
    /\ Cardinality(votes[m]) >= Quorum
    /\ session[s] = NONE
    /\ m \notin launched
    /\ ~OnSomeServer(m)
    /\ session' = [session EXCEPT ![s] = m]
    /\ launched' = launched \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed>>

Finish(s) ==
    /\ session[s] # NONE
    /\ session' = [session EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, launched, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ votes' = [m \in Matches |-> votes[m] \ {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<session, launched>>

Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, session, launched>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, m \in Matches : Vote(p, m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches, s \in Servers : Launch(m, s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Finish(s)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Recover(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
    \A s \in Servers : \A t \in Servers :
        (session[s] # NONE /\ session[s] = session[t]) => s = t

    /\ final \subseteq Surgeries
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ pending \subseteq Props
    /\ slow \subseteq Surgeries

Init ==
    /\ assign = [sg \in Surgeries |-> NONE]
    /\ final = {}
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ slow = {}

Propose(sg, r) ==
    /\ sg \notin final
    /\ <<sg, r, ver>> \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<sg, r, ver>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, final, ver, slow>>

Commit(sg, r, rv) ==
    /\ <<sg, r, rv>> \in pending
    /\ rv = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ sg \notin final
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![sg] = r]
    /\ final' = final \cup {sg}
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ pending' = pending \ {<<sg, r, rv>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

    /\ <<sg, r, rv>> \in pending
    /\ rv # ver
    /\ pending' = (pending \ {<<sg, r, rv>>}) \cup {<<sg, r, ver>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, final, ver, slow>>

Cancel(sg) ==
    /\ sg \notin final
    /\ assign[sg] # NONE
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![sg] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<final, ver, pending, slow>>

Tentative(sg, r) ==
    /\ sg \notin final
    /\ assign[sg] = NONE
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![sg] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<final, ver, pending, slow>>

MarkSlow(sg) ==
    /\ sg \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {sg}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, final, ver, pending>>

ClearSlow(sg) ==
    /\ sg \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {sg}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, final, ver, pending>>

Next ==

    \/ \E sg \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms, rv \in 0 .. MaxVer : Commit(sg, r, rv)
    \/ \E sg \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms, rv \in 0 .. MaxVer : Refresh(sg, r, rv)
    \/ \E sg \in Surgeries : Cancel(sg)
    \/ \E sg \in Surgeries, r \in Rooms : Tentative(sg, r)
    \/ \E sg \in Surgeries : MarkSlow(sg)
    \/ \E sg \in Surgeries : ClearSlow(sg)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
